name: Prime Cabinet Stain-Blocking (Brush)
intent: Brush one coat of shellac-based stain-blocking primer on stained cabinet surfaces. Fires only when substrate_state is SS_STAINED and application_method is brush. Kills stain bleed-through before topcoat.
doctrine: Shellac stain-blocker — ~15% slower than wood primer brush (careful application needed to avoid brush marks in fast-drying shellac). Material system: SYS_PRIMER_MDF_SHELLAC.
